_about: TEMPESTA URSA (Lamborghini Urus Performante): its digital cluster and its centre screen are blank in the model (their faces map to one flat strip of the interior texture), so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital cluster in Lamborghini's yellow-green, the centre screen's pages.
